title: An office, never seen
logline: Julian's office, drawn from one sentence in 2014: a desk, a window, a printed Sunday — the dog at the top of the stairs — pinned where a man read it and had to go for a walk.

panels.composition: A clean office with a glass wall and a city beyond, a standing desk, and pinned to a fabric panel beside a monitor, a printout of a watercolor Sunday: a dog at the top of bluff stairs. The chair empty. A jacket on it, gray.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a clean modern office with a glass wall onto a city, a standing desk, and a printed watercolor comic page pinned to a fabric panel beside a monitor, an empty chair with a gray jacket on it, no people, no words
image.notes: dw_2014-03-16 printed and pinned. Julian's office, from his one sentence (dw_2014-07-23). Drawn fair.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The office where a stranger read the Sunday.
